title: 11 Best Wine Bars in Tbilisi — The Unfiltered Guide
description: The best wine bars in Tbilisi — curated from Reddit reviews. 8000 Vintages, DADI, Vino Underground, St.Bunny, Patara Dzagli & more. Qvevri wines, amber tastings, and honest verdicts.

places.name: 8000 Vintages

redditQuotes.text: I like 8000 Vintages (good recommendations, good food and reasonable prices). They have a few locations but the one I'd go to is on Tabukashvili Street.

8000 Vintages is a place for locals and wine education. It is a place to have a blind tasting and converse with the in-house sommelier. It's the massive selection and affordable prices that keep us returning with each visit to the city.
redditQuotes.source: — portwineandadventure.com · Best Wine Bars in Tbilisi guide

places.verdict: The definitive Tbilisi wine experience. Named after the 8,000 years of Georgian winemaking, this is where you come for a proper education — guided tastings with an in-house sommelier, 200+ bottles spanning every region, and four locations across Tbilisi.

comparison.best for: First-time Georgian wine education and comprehensive tastings
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 1,231 reviews · 4 Tbilisi locations · Massive selection · Professional sommelier tastings
comparison.what to order: Book a tasting flight (4–6 wines, ~35–60 GEL). Ask for Saperavi, Rkatsiteli amber, and a Kisi if they have it. The food boards pair well — Georgian cheese, churchkhela, and cured meats.
comparison.insider tip: The Tabukashvili Street flagship is best for tastings. The Rustaveli location is perfect for a quick glass before the Opera. Book ahead on weekends — it fills up fast.

places.whatToOrder: Book a tasting flight (4–6 wines, ~35–60 GEL). Ask for Saperavi, Rkatsiteli amber, and a Kisi if they have it. The food boards pair well — Georgian cheese, churchkhela, and cured meats.

places.name: DADI Wine Bar

redditQuotes.text: DADI's by-the-glass selection is impressive, featuring roughly 30 offerings daily and a multi-page bottle list spanning all corners of the country, including labels from small producers that you would be hard-pressed to find elsewhere.
redditQuotes.source: — portwineandadventure.com · Best Wine Bars in Tbilisi guide

places.verdict: Organic, biodynamic, artisanal wines from family-owned wineries across Georgia. The by-the-glass selection (~30 daily offerings) is one of the best in the city, and the small bites are dangerously good.

comparison.best for: Organic and biodynamic wine enthusiasts; those who want depth without pretension
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 1,210 reviews · ~30 wines by the glass · Multi-page bottle list · Small producer focus
comparison.what to order: Ask for the Georgian wine experience flight. Then order a few small plates — the food here almost tempts you to stay for dinner. Try an amber wine from a producer you haven't heard of.
comparison.insider tip: Open since 2017 and centered around their love for food and artisanal wine. Labels from small producers that you'd be hard-pressed to find elsewhere in Tbilisi. Great for a slow afternoon session.

places.whatToOrder: Ask for the Georgian wine experience flight. Then order a few small plates — the food here almost tempts you to stay for dinner. Try an amber wine from a producer you haven't heard of.
places.editorialSummary: Organic, biodynamic, artisanal wines from family-owned wineries across Georgia. The by-the-glass selection (~30 daily offerings) is one of the best in the city, and the small bites are dangerously good.
places.bestFor: Organic and biodynamic wine enthusiasts; those who want depth without pretension

places.name: ღvino Underground

redditQuotes.text: Vino Underground! The place is very cozy, the owner speaks great English, is super nice and will take you on a personal tour of Georgian wines.
redditQuotes.source: — r/tbilisi · Visiting Tbilisi Wine Bars thread, 2024

redditQuotes.text: The basement wine bar and shop is the best place in Tbilisi to buy natural Georgian wines. It boasts a selection of about 350 different bottles, some of which are also available by the glass.
redditQuotes.source: — everybodyhatesatourist.net · Wine Bars in Tbilisi guide

places.verdict: The natural wine temple of Tbilisi. Owned by John Wurdeman of Pheasant's Tears winery, this basement bar has ~350 bottles including rare wines from producers who don't sell anywhere else. If you care about natural wine, this is pilgrimage-level.

comparison.best for: Serious natural wine lovers seeking rare Georgian bottles
comparison.strengths: ~350 different bottles · Rare producers exclusive to this bar · Owner is John Wurdeman (Pheasant's Tears)
comparison.what to order: Ask the staff — they're passionate and knowledgeable. Try a Pét-nat (Georgian sparkling) if they have one open, and an amber wine from a producer you can't find elsewhere. Iago's Winery bottles appear here when available.
comparison.insider tip: The vibe is classic rock on vinyl (Led Zeppelin, Queen), dim lighting, and serious wine conversation. Best on a quiet weekday evening when staff have time to guide you through the selection.

places.whatToOrder: Ask the staff — they're passionate and knowledgeable. Try a Pét-nat (Georgian sparkling) if they have one open, and an amber wine from a producer you can't find elsewhere. Iago's Winery bottles appear here when available.

places.name: St.Bunny

redditQuotes.text: In addition to 300 different wines by the bottle, 30 wines are available by the glass. They also offer full wine tastings. The rabbit khinkali and khachapuri with Gorgonzola cheese, pear, and pancetta were incredible.
redditQuotes.source: — everybodyhatesatourist.net · Wine Bars in Tbilisi guide

places.verdict: More than a wine bar — a full restaurant serving Georgian and Ukrainian food with 300 wines by the bottle and 30 by the glass. The rabbit khinkali and Gorgonzola khachapuri are as memorable as the wine list. Live piano. Classy but not stiff.

comparison.best for: Wine dinner pairing; those who want a full meal with their wine exploration
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 2,420 reviews · 300 wines by bottle · 30 by glass · Full kitchen with creative Georgian fusion
comparison.what to order: Rabbit khinkali, khachapuri with Gorgonzola/pear/pancetta, and a Simoneti Rkatsiteli amber wine. Finish with a Barbale Late Harvest white for dessert.
comparison.insider tip: Identifies as women-owned. The hookah bar is in a separate building. Book for dinner and plan to spend the evening — the piano player sets the mood perfectly.

places.whatToOrder: Rabbit khinkali, khachapuri with Gorgonzola/pear/pancetta, and a Simoneti Rkatsiteli amber wine. Finish with a Barbale Late Harvest white for dessert.
places.editorialSummary: More than a wine bar — a full restaurant serving Georgian and Ukrainian food with 300 wines by the bottle and 30 by the glass. The rabbit khinkali and Gorgonzola khachapuri are as memorable as the wine list. Live piano. Classy but not stiff.
places.bestFor: Wine dinner pairing; those who want a full meal with their wine exploration

places.name: Patara Dzagli

redditQuotes.text: The owners are excited about wine and wine education, holding WSET certifications. You will find small production, boutique wines here; just ask them to show you their rare bottles that can't be found anywhere else in Tbilisi.
redditQuotes.source: — portwineandadventure.com · Best Wine Bars in Tbilisi guide

places.verdict: A perfect 5.0★ rating from 252 reviews. The owners hold WSET certifications and carry small-production, boutique wines that can't be found anywhere else in Tbilisi. Hidden gem on a touristy street — ignore the hawkers and walk in.

comparison.best for: Rare boutique wines; expert guidance from WSET-certified owners
comparison.strengths: Perfect 5.0★ · WSET certified · Small production wines · Excellent glassware
comparison.what to order: Ask the owners to show you their rare bottles that can't be found elsewhere. They also serve coffee, making it a great morning-to-evening stop. The glassware is some of the best in the city.
comparison.insider tip: Located on Kote Afkhazi Street, a touristy strip lined with restaurant hawkers. Don't let that deter you — Patara Dzagli is the opposite of a tourist trap. The owners genuinely love wine education.

places.whatToOrder: Ask the owners to show you their rare bottles that can't be found elsewhere. They also serve coffee, making it a great morning-to-evening stop. The glassware is some of the best in the city.
places.editorialSummary: A perfect 5.0★ rating from 252 reviews. The owners hold WSET certifications and carry small-production, boutique wines that can't be found anywhere else in Tbilisi. Hidden gem on a touristy street — ignore the hawkers and walk in.
places.bestFor: Rare boutique wines; expert guidance from WSET-certified owners

places.name: Wine Gallery

redditQuotes.text: Wine Gallery is appropriately named. It's a beautiful store with a massive selection of wine that's appealingly displayed. The staff are helpful, offering free tastes from a selection of open bottles.
redditQuotes.source: — everybodyhatesatourist.net · Wine Bars in Tbilisi guide

places.verdict: The most visually stunning wine shop in Tbilisi — a massive, beautifully displayed selection of Georgian wines and chacha. Staff offer free tastes from open bottles. Almost intimidating to walk into, but the experience is worth it.

comparison.best for: Buying bottles to take home; browsing the full breadth of Georgian wine
comparison.strengths: 4.9★ from 1,633 reviews · Huge selection · Free tastings · Beautiful space · Chacha collection
comparison.what to order: Browse and ask for recommendations. Staff will open bottles for you to taste. Good for building a mixed case to take home. The chacha section is excellent too.
comparison.insider tip: Located in Chugureti, right next to Wine Merchants. Do both in one trip — Wine Gallery for the massive selection and ambiance, Wine Merchants for the curated rarities that Wine Gallery might not have.

places.whatToOrder: Browse and ask for recommendations. Staff will open bottles for you to taste. Good for building a mixed case to take home. The chacha section is excellent too.
places.editorialSummary: The most visually stunning wine shop in Tbilisi — a massive, beautifully displayed selection of Georgian wines and chacha. Staff offer free tastes from open bottles. Almost intimidating to walk into, but the experience is worth it.
places.bestFor: Buying bottles to take home; browsing the full breadth of Georgian wine

places.name: Nino Meris Wine Selection

redditQuotes.text: She was quoted as saying, 'I am proud to call myself a Georgian woman winemaker. Only I and my mother care about wines with no man entering the wine cellar during the winemaking process.' This talented winemaker will help you select a wine suited to your palate.
redditQuotes.source: — portwineandadventure.com · Best Wine Bars in Tbilisi guide

places.verdict: The most personal wine experience in Tbilisi. Owned by a young woman winemaker who sells wines from across Georgia alongside her own Kakheti vineyard production. "I am proud to call myself a Georgian woman winemaker. Only I and my mother care about wines." Tiny but unforgettable.

comparison.best for: Personal wine conversations; meeting an actual Georgian winemaker; intimate tastings
comparison.strengths: 4.9★ · Owner is a practicing winemaker · Personal guidance · Old Town Sioni Street location
comparison.what to order: Ask Nino to guide you — she'll select wines suited to your palate and join you in conversation. Try her own vineyard's production alongside her curated picks from other regions.
comparison.insider tip: The shop is no wider than a traditional tone oven, sandwiched between two restaurants on Sioni Street. It looks like it used to be a breezeway. Don't walk past it — step inside.

places.whatToOrder: Ask Nino to guide you — she'll select wines suited to your palate and join you in conversation. Try her own vineyard's production alongside her curated picks from other regions.

"I am proud to call myself a Georgian woman winemaker. Only I and my mother care about wines." Tiny but unforgettable.
places.bestFor: Personal wine conversations; meeting an actual Georgian winemaker; intimate tastings

places.name: Tsangala's Wine Shop & Bar

redditQuotes.text: If you're going to Gabriadze Theater, wines by the glass there start at 30 lari, double the price of a glass across the street at Tsangala's. Do yourself a favor and swing by here first for your pre-show beverage.
redditQuotes.source: — portwineandadventure.com · Best Wine Bars in Tbilisi guide

places.verdict: A quaint, no-menu wine bar near the Clock Tower and Gabriadze Theater. Staff guide you based on taste preferences — no printed list, just conversation. Finish with house-made chacha. Perfect pre-show drink at half the price of the theater's own bar.

comparison.best for: Pre-theater drinks; guided tastings without pretension; chacha tasting
comparison.strengths: 4.8★ · Location near Gabriadze Theater · No menu, just conversation · House-made chacha
comparison.what to order: Tell the staff what flavors you like and let them choose. No menus here. End with their house-made chacha — it's smoother than what you'll find at most bars.
comparison.insider tip: Wines by the glass at Gabriadze Theater start at 30 GEL — double the price across the street at Tsangala's. Save your money, drink here first, then walk to the show.

places.whatToOrder: Tell the staff what flavors you like and let them choose. No menus here. End with their house-made chacha — it's smoother than what you'll find at most bars.

places.bestFor: Pre-theater drinks; guided tastings without pretension; chacha tasting

places.name: Poliphonia Natural Wine

redditQuotes.text: The Georgian, Asian, and Italian fusion food was some of the best bites we had in our time in Tbilisi. Behind the bar, there is also a large selection of infused chachas, ranging from more traditional to spicy and sweet flavors.
redditQuotes.source: — portwineandadventure.com · Best Wine Bars in Tbilisi guide

places.verdict: Natural Georgian wines with a fusion food menu (Georgian-Asian-Italian) that produced some of the best bites one blog found in all of Tbilisi. The infused chacha collection — from traditional to spicy to sweet — is exceptional.

comparison.best for: Natural wine with excellent food; infused chacha tasting; a full evening out
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ · Outstanding fusion food · Infused chacha range · Natural wine focus · Women-owned
comparison.what to order: Order the food — it's not an afterthought here. The Georgian-Asian-Italian fusion is genuinely creative. Pair with a natural wine flight. Try the infused chachas at the end.

places.name: Wine Merchants

redditQuotes.text: The wine shop's bottle selection is not as big as that of some other places. However, the selection is well-curated. Wine Gallery didn't have the wine in stock, but Wine Merchants did.
redditQuotes.source: — everybodyhatesatourist.net · Wine Bars in Tbilisi guide

places.verdict: Smaller and more curated than Wine Gallery next door. The selection is well-chosen over massive, and they stock bottles that the bigger shops miss. Chill vibes, 80s pop on the speakers, and a large by-the-glass selection.

comparison.best for: Finding specific wines the bigger shops don't carry; relaxed afternoon session
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ · Well-curated · Rare stock · Hosts wine tastings and tours · Chugureti location
comparison.what to order: An amber Kisi-Khikhvi-Mtsvane qvevri blend if they have one open — it's a beautiful multi-grape amber style unique to Georgia.
comparison.insider tip: Right around the corner from Wine Gallery. Hit both — Wine Gallery for the massive selection, then Wine Merchants for the curated finds that the bigger shop missed.

places.name: Wine Boutique Tbilisi

redditQuotes.text: The shop is decorated with bright and engaging paintings from one of the shop employees, a Frenchman who came to Tbilisi for a girl and stayed for the wine.
redditQuotes.source: — portwineandadventure.com · Best Wine Bars in Tbilisi guide

places.verdict: Up the hill from Rustaveli, away from the crowds, in a quiet old row house decorated with paintings by one of the employees — a Frenchman who came to Tbilisi for a girl and stayed for the wine. BYO food welcome. Magnums available.

comparison.best for: Quiet, off-the-beaten-path wine session; celebrating with a magnum; art lovers
comparison.strengths: 4.8★ · Quiet street · Art-filled interior · Magnums available · BYO food
comparison.what to order: Taste by the glass or buy a bottle at near-retail markup. Bring your own food or order delivery — they don't serve food but encourage it. If celebrating, ask about the magnums.
comparison.insider tip: The paintings on the walls are by a French employee who moved to Tbilisi for love and stayed for the wine. A story that perfectly encapsulates this city's pull.
